parts.description: An effect that allows you to animate elements with a fade effect on first view or load.

parts.name: primitives-effects-highlight
parts.title: Highlight
parts.description: A highlight effect that allows you to highlight elements on hover, click or with a controlled value.

parts.name: primitives-effects-image-zoom
parts.title: Image Zoom
parts.description: An effect that allows you to zoom in on an image on hover.

parts.name: primitives-effects-magnetic
parts.title: Magnetic
parts.description: A magnetic effect that clings to the cursor, creating a magnetic attraction effect.

parts.name: primitives-effects-particles
parts.title: Particles
parts.description: A particles effect that creates a particle system.

parts.name: primitives-effects-shine
parts.title: Shine
parts.description: An animated light sweep effect with configurable timing, colors, and triggers (hover, tap, or continuous).

parts.name: primitives-effects-slide
parts.title: Slide
parts.description: An effect that allows you to animate elements with a slide effect on first view or load.

parts.name: primitives-effects-theme-toggler
parts.title: Theme Toggler
parts.description: An effect that allows you to toggle the theme gradually.

parts.name: primitives-effects-tilt
parts.title: Tilt
parts.description: An effect that allows you to animate elements with a tilt effect on mouse hover.

parts.name: primitives-effects-zoom
parts.title: Zoom
parts.description: An effect that allows you to animate elements with a zoom effect on first view or load.

parts.name: primitives-headless-checkbox
parts.title: Headless Checkbox
parts.description: Checkboxes provide the same functionality as native HTML checkboxes, without any of the styling, giving you a clean slate to design them however you'd like.

parts.name: primitives-headless-dialog
parts.title: Headless Dialog
parts.description: A fully-managed, renderless dialog component jam-packed with accessibility and keyboard features, perfect for building completely custom dialogs and alerts.

parts.name: primitives-headless-disclosure
parts.title: Headless Disclosure
parts.description: A simple, accessible foundation for building custom UIs that show and hide content, like togglable accordion panels.

parts.name: primitives-headless-popover
parts.title: Headless Popover
parts.description: Popovers are perfect for floating panels with arbitrary content like navigation menus, mobile menus and flyout menus.

parts.name: primitives-headless-switch
parts.title: Headless Switch
parts.description: Switches are a pleasant interface for toggling a value between two states, and offer the same semantics and keyboard navigation as native checkbox elements.

parts.name: primitives-headless-tabs
parts.title: Headless Tabs
parts.description: Easily create accessible, fully customizable tab interfaces, with robust focus management and keyboard navigation support.

parts.name: primitives-radix-accordion
parts.title: Radix Accordion
parts.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal an associated section of content.

parts.name: primitives-radix-alert-dialog
parts.title: Radix Alert Dialog
parts.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

parts.name: primitives-radix-checkbox
parts.title: Radix Checkbox
parts.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

parts.name: primitives-radix-collapsible
parts.title: Radix Collapsible
parts.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

parts.name: primitives-radix-dialog
parts.title: Radix Dialog
parts.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

parts.name: primitives-radix-dropdown-menu
parts.title: Radix Dropdown Menu
parts.description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.

parts.name: primitives-radix-files
parts.title: Files
parts.description: A component that allows you to display a list of files and folders.

parts.name: primitives-radix-hover-card
parts.title: Radix Hover Card
parts.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

parts.name: primitives-radix-popover
parts.title: Radix Popover
parts.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

parts.name: primitives-radix-preview-link-card
parts.title: Radix Preview Link Card
parts.description: Displays a preview image of a link when hovered.

parts.name: primitives-radix-progress
parts.title: Radix Progress
parts.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.

parts.name: primitives-radix-radio-group
parts.title: Radix Radio Group
parts.description: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

parts.name: primitives-radix-sheet
parts.title: Radix Sheet
parts.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

parts.name: primitives-radix-switch
parts.title: Radix Switch
parts.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

parts.name: primitives-radix-tabs
parts.title: Radix Tabs
parts.description: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.

parts.name: primitives-radix-toggle-group
parts.title: Radix Toggle Group
parts.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.

parts.name: primitives-radix-toggle
parts.title: Radix Toggle
parts.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

parts.name: primitives-radix-tooltip
parts.title: Radix Tooltip
parts.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

parts.name: primitives-texts-morphing
parts.title: Morphing Text
parts.description: A text component that smoothly morphs characters to transition between strings.
